design_note: This is a fixed, curated prompt collection, not a random sample of writing tasks. Each public task must be run with both private labels; the topic is never assigned to a particular label. Repeated labels, model conditions and transformations are paired measurements, not independent samples. Nearby confirmation topics form thematic families and can be correlated.
